thread:
Maya (Support): FYI customer Lumina says they were charged twice after they upgraded and we added a PO mid-cycle. Both charges hit their card and one invoice is marked 'paid' and the other 'paid' as well. They want a refund for the accidental extra renewal.

Jasper (Billing): Can you paste the invoice IDs and the billing events?

Maya (Support): Invoice IDs: inv_20230456 (upgrade charge, $2,400 prorated + immediate balance) and inv_20230457 (full annual renewal, $24,000). Customer says they had a mid-cycle upgrade and then their finance team uploaded a PO. They got charged for both at nearly the same time.

Maya (Support): Posting webhook payloads we received (stripped PII):
```
{
  "event": "invoice.created",
  "invoice": {"id":"inv_20230456","status":"paid","amount":2400},
  "meta": {"trigger":"upgrade","timestamp":1709001200}
}
---
{
  "event": "invoice.created",
  "invoice": {"id":"inv_20230457","status":"paid","amount":24000},
  "meta": {"trigger":"auto_renew","timestamp":1709001212}
}
```

billing-bot: Detected: two invoice.created events within 15s for same subscription: sub_7788. Possible race when po_required flag toggled during checkout.

Sam (Payments): Thx — checking gateway webhooks and duplicate payment attempts. If both were captured by the gateway we'll need to refund one and create a credit note. I’ll check capture IDs.

Jasper (Billing): This looks like the edge-case we discussed in Q1: if a PO is added with po_required toggled after the invoice generation step, the system creates a prorate invoice and then the scheduled renewal still fires because the subscription state didn't flip to pending. We need to confirm sequence.

Maya (Support): I confirmed timeline with timestamps from internal audit.log:
```
1709001198 subscription.updated {"po_required": true} by user finance@lumina
1709001200 invoice.generated inv_20230456 (prorate)
1709001210 invoice.generated inv_20230457 (renewal)
1709001215 payment.attempted pay_9901 -> succeeded
1709001216 payment.attempted pay_9902 -> succeeded
```

Olivia (SE): Ouch. So two payments captured. Which one should we refund? The customer asked for the renewal reversal (they expect prorate to apply and annual charge to be adjusted).

Sam (Payments): Refund plan: refund the renewal full-charge (inv_20230457) to the card, issue credit note referencing inv_20230457, and apply a negative invoice/credit towards the subscription so ledger balances. I'll escalate to payments ops for immediate refund.

Jasper (Billing): For audit, we should: 1) create a reversal credit note (cn_30457_rev) referencing inv_20230457, 2) set subscription.next_invoice to reflect prorated balance, 3) add internal note linking to the PO upload event. Also schedule rollback test.

Maya (Support): I've opened a support case for Lumina (Case #S-9098) and messaged the customer: "We're processing a refund for the duplicate renewal and will confirm once the credit posts (2-5 business days)." They acknowledged. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2023-456-prorate-dup-invoice, severity: low, owner: jasper.billing, linked tickets: S-9098.

Sam (Payments): Refund initiated via gateway: refund_id r_55022 against capture pay_9902 (inv_20230457). Refund status: pending (gateway). Will update when cleared.

Jasper (Billing): Creating credit note now. Steps (internal KB):
1) Billing UI -> Invoices -> inv_20230457 -> Actions -> Create credit note
2) Link credit note to subscription and mark as refunded once gateway confirms
3) Run reconciliation script: `scripts/reconcile_subscriptions --sub sub_7788 --since 1709001100`

Maya (Support): Customer updated: "Thanks, please confirm when money is back on card."

Sam (Payments): Gateway returned refund success: r_55022 -> succeeded at 1709003200. Refund amount $24,000.

Jasper (Billing): Credit note cn_30457_rev created and applied at 1709003250. Ledger shows balance zero for the duplicated charge. Added internal note linking audit log & PO upload.

Olivia (SE): Action items: - Patch to ensure we atomically flip subscription.po_required before invoice generation. - Add regression test for concurrent PO upload + upgrade flow. - Add an alert when >1 invoice.created within 30s for same subscription.

Maya (Support): Customer updated with confirmation and refund receipt, asked to allow 2-3 business days for bank processing. Customer is satisfied and asked for a short summary email, which I sent. :white_check_mark:

Jasper (Billing): Closing internal incident after deploying hotfix to queue ordering. Will monitor for similar signals.

Maya (Support): Marking case S-9098 resolved. Closing thread.
